prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original character design reference for a Japanese-anime-style 3D Chinese literature adventure game. Clean professional anime model sheet, sophisticated 6.5-head young-adult proportions, large expressive almond eyes, elegant pointed chin, appealing face, crisp controlled linework and two-tone cel shading. No photorealism, no skin pores, no doll/uncanny face, no chibi, no bulky plastic toy anatomy. All clothing is practical, modest, fully covered Chinese-inspired fantasy clothing with clear layered silhouettes, ivory + bright jade/teal + restrained warm-gold accents. Four separate panels on a warm white background: a large face close-up and three full-body front/three-quarter views of the SAME person wearing scholar clothes, traveler clothes, and lightweight lamellar armor respectively. Hands and boots visible, no cropped limbs, calm confident expressions, no weapons, no text, no logos, no watermark. Intended as an achievable reference for a real rigged game model, simple clean material colors rather than ornate noisy patterns. Subject: an original Chinese male scholar-adventurer, clearly a young adult about 22. Lean athletic build, youthful handsome anime face, blue-black layered medium-short hair with swept bangs, one subtle jade hair ornament, teal eyes. Scholar outfit: elegant ivory and jade crossed-collar tunic, long split robe and fitted dark trousers. Traveler: short cape, crossbody satchel, shorter tunic with fitted trousers. Armor: compact jade-blue lamellar vest over ivory sleeves with small bronze guards, no oversized shoulder pads.
